baseExperiment.overrideRule: This contract prospectively replaces only the economics accounting of the base v2 experiment; all non-economics v2 rules remain unchanged.

accountingUnit.unit: scenario USD per registered initial query submission

B.name: conditionalReplacementSaving
B.description: Conditional Spark compute cost avoided by recovery versus the matched recovery-disabled replacement control, averaged over the frozen failure-point distribution. B is gross of H and all incremental provider/traffic/storage charges.

H.name: incrementalFirstAttemptSparkCost
H.description: Incremental Spark driver/executor CPU, memory and wait work caused by recovery identity/certification, lookup, validation, scheduling bookkeeping and publication-side Spark work. Provider service work is excluded.

S.name: marginalRetainedStorageAndIndexCost
S.description: Marginal retained payload/index cost attributable to reusable artifacts, averaged over all registered initial submissions, with zero contribution when no retention is incurred.

T_initial.name: incrementalInitialTrafficCost
T_initial.description: Incremental publication/write/copy traffic attributable to recovery on initial submissions.

P_initial.name: incrementalInitialProviderServiceCost
P_initial.description: Marginal provider service work attributable to recovery on initial submissions and not already represented by fixed greenfield capacity.

T_retry.name: incrementalRetryTrafficCost
T_retry.description: Incremental recovery-read/retry traffic attributable to recovery, conditional on a registered replacement opportunity.

P_retry.name: incrementalRetryProviderServiceCost
P_retry.description: Marginal provider service work attributable to recovery during replacement, conditional on a registered replacement opportunity.

F.name: greenfieldFixedCapacityAllocation
F.description: Fixed provider introduction/capacity allocation normalized to the same per-submission accounting unit. It is separate from marginal per-artifact terms.

populationRules.failedInitialSubmissionRule: Retain every registered initial submission. Charge only recovery-specific work actually incurred before failure or cancellation; a component not reached contributes zero. Do not condition H or publication cost on initial success.
populationRules.publicationAttemptRule: Every enabled publication attempt remains in the initial-submission denominator. A submission with no publication copy contributes zero copy bytes but does not erase H.
populationRules.allMissRule: Enabled misses remain in the initial-submission denominator and may have positive H even when B is zero.

byteAccounting.rawCounters: Gross arm bytes may be retained as provenance.
byteAccounting.economicCharge: Only recovery-attributable incremental bytes versus the same-provider matched control enter T_initial or T_retry.
byteAccounting.pairedDifferenceFallback: If direct feature-attributable byte counters are unavailable, use the prespecified paired enabled-minus-control byte difference without dropping negative/noisy pairs.

formulas.existingProviderPerStratum: p * (B - T_retry - P_retry) - H - S - T_initial - P_initial
formulas.greenfieldPerStratum: p * (B - T_retry_greenfield - P_retry_greenfield) - H - S_greenfield - T_initial_greenfield - P_initial_greenfield
formulas.greenfieldMarginalExclusionRule: Any storage, provider service or traffic already paid by F is zero in the corresponding greenfield marginal term; genuinely incremental external charges remain.

uncertainty.method: deterministic stratified paired bootstrap of the complete economic ledger
uncertainty.retrySamplingUnit: paired restart repetition within each fixed workload/input-scale/failure-point cell
uncertainty.initialSamplingUnit: paired no-failure repetition within each fixed workload/input-scale cell
uncertainty.jointResamplingRule: Primitive cost terms observed on the same attempt or pair are resampled together so covariance is retained; they are not bootstrapped independently and recombined by interval endpoints.
replicateProcedure: resample paired primitive records within every fixed registered stratum
compute B, H, S, T_initial, P_initial, T_retry and P_retry from that replicate using the same frozen weights
convert every primitive term to the common scenario-USD unit using the prespecified scenario rates
evaluate the complete existing-provider formula for the replicate
evaluate the complete greenfield formula for the replicate and subtract F exactly once
uncertainty.finalInterval: 2.5th and 97.5th percentiles of the complete net-value replicate distribution for each deployment lens
uncertainty.missingTermRule: If a required measured term or registered stratum is unavailable, the economics result is INDETERMINATE; do not substitute zero, drop the stratum, or renormalize weights.

workedLedgerUnit: illustrative common-cost units per registered initial submission; these are specification examples, not benchmark results
